title: Collections and Categories
meta: We group your products into clear collections and categories that are easy to browse, with menus and filters. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Collections and categories shoppers can actually browse
overview: A good catalog tree lets a shopper find a product in two or three clicks. We plan the categories with you, build the collections in your store, assign every product and connect them to your menu and filters. Rules based on tags or product type keep new products landing in the right place by themselves. You get a simple map of the structure to keep for later.

faq: Can you plan the categories if I am not sure?
Yes. Send your product list and we propose a structure based on how shoppers search for those items. You approve the plan before we build, and you can adjust it first.
Will this change my page links?
Collection links change only if you rename a collection. When that happens, we add redirects so old links keep working, and we list them in the handover notes.
They fill themselves from rules such as a tag, product type, vendor or price range. Add a new product with the right tag and it appears in the right collection without extra work.
Do you work on stores other than Shopify?

Yes. WooCommerce, BigCommerce and most store platforms have categories or collections. Tell us your platform in the order form and we use the native features. Some options, such as rules, depend on the platform.
